title: Separation Reasons — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: The reasons an employee's service can end — resignation, termination, end of contract and so on. Each separation record names one.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: IsSystemRecord
fields.html:
What it is. Marks a reason that came with the system.

Why it matters. Only an administrator can edit or delete a system reason.

fields.label: AllowAdvanceEoS
fields.html:
What it is. Meant to allow end-of-service benefits to be paid in advance for this reason.

Why it matters. Not read at present.
